[{"node": "menu_content107", "element": "menu_content", "data": {"label": "Menus", "key": "menus_menu_content", "id": "menus_menu_content", "name": "menus_menu_content"}, "elements": [{"node": "markdown101", "element": "markdown", "data": {"label": "Menus and the Menu Manager", "key": "md_menus_and_the_menu_manager", "id": "menus-and-the-menu-manager", "name": "md_menus_and_the_menu_manager", "value": "# Menus and the Menu Manager

A **menu** is the list of items a restaurant sells, in the order they appear. A company can have several menus (Lunch, Dinner, Bar, Brunch…). Open the **Menu Manager** from the floor plan while editing:

- the list on the left shows each menu, how many items it has, the rooms that use it and a clock on scheduled menus;
- the **star** marks the restaurant's menu;
- the **Items** tab shows every item: tap one to add it to the menu or take it off; the **Menu** tab shows only what's on the menu;
- the eye turns a menu on or off; a menu that is off never sells.
"}}, {"node": "markdown102", "element": "markdown", "data": {"label": "The menu in force", "key": "md_the_menu_in_force", "id": "the-menu-in-force", "name": "md_the_menu_in_force", "value": "# The menu in force

For each room, Ren picks the menu in force in this order:

1. the **room's own menu** (set when editing the room);
2. a **scheduled menu** whose hours cover now (breakfast 7–11, happy hour 4–6…);
3. the **restaurant's menu** (the star);
4. the company's default menu.

Only menus that are on count. The order screen shows which menu is in force and switches by itself when a schedule starts or ends.
"}}, {"node": "markdown103", "element": "markdown", "data": {"label": "Menu prices", "key": "md_menu_prices", "id": "menu-prices", "name": "md_menu_prices", "value": "# Menu prices

A menu row can have its own **Menu Price**; otherwise the item price of the price list applies. The price shown in the catalog is exactly what is charged. A line keeps the price it was ordered at, even if the happy hour ends before the check is paid.
"}}, {"node": "markdown104", "element": "markdown", "data": {"label": "Tags and allergens", "key": "md_tags_and_allergens", "id": "tags-and-allergens", "name": "md_tags_and_allergens", "value": "# Tags and allergens

**Menu Tags** mark items as *Vegetarian, Vegan, Gluten-free, Spicy* and the US "Big 9" allergens (peanuts, tree nuts, milk, eggs, wheat, soy, fish, shellfish, sesame). Tags have an abbreviation and a color; the ones marked as filters appear as buttons in the catalog. Add your own tags anytime.
"}}, {"node": "markdown105", "element": "markdown", "data": {"label": "Sold out (86)", "key": "md_sold_out_86", "id": "sold-out-86", "name": "md_sold_out_86", "value": "# Sold out (86)

Mark an item **sold out** with the **86** button in the order screen. It is greyed out on every screen of that restaurant at once, and the server refuses new lines of it; lines already ordered keep working. Tap it again when it is back.
"}}, {"node": "markdown106", "element": "markdown", "data": {"label": "Selling only what's on the menu", "key": "md_selling_only_what_s_on_the_menu", "id": "selling-only-what-s-on-the-menu", "name": "md_selling_only_what_s_on_the_menu", "value": "# Selling only what's on the menu

By default the menu decides what the catalog shows. Turn on **Sell only items on the menu** in Restaurant Settings to also refuse anything that isn't on the menu in force.
"}}]}]
